_comment: What editorconfig-checker holds this repository to. .editorconfig states the rules; this
file only says which of them the checker enforces, and why one of them it does not.
IndentSize is off. It reads every line's left padding as a multiple of the section's
indent_size, which an aligned continuation line, a wrapped argument list and an ASCII
diagram are all not, so it reported 343 findings over code that keeps the indentation
the file says it keeps. Enforcing it would mean reformatting to suit the checker rather
than the reader. IndentStyle stays on, so spaces against tabs is still checked.
What is left is what breaks something here rather than a taste: end_of_line, which
AGENTS.md calls load-bearing because a carriage return ends up inside a path the
sandbox then fails to grant, charset, trailing whitespace and the final newline.
